easy.q: Which organelle is known as the powerhouse of the cell?
Explain two differences between a plant cell and an animal cell.
easy.rubric: Award up to 2 marks. 1 mark: plant cells have a cell wall (animal cells do not). 1 mark: plant cells have chloroplasts (animal cells do not). Accept a large permanent vacuole or a typically more regular shape as a difference. Do not penalise minor spelling slips; note them separately.
